summary: Red Compass is an interactive Mars exploration and Marswalk planning platform focused on Jezero Crater, the landing site of NASA's Perseverance rover. It combines real NASA and USGS planetary datasets in a 2D and 3D mapping environment, allowing users to explore Martian terrain, elevation, slope, geology, thermal conditions, and rover activity. The platform generates multiple walking route options between selected locations, evaluates them based on walking time, steep terrain, climbing, and rough ground, then ranks them for comparison. It also provides terrain profiles, hazard information, mission briefings, and interactive landmarks to support informed exploration planning.
details: Red Compass is an interactive Martian exploration and Marswalk planning platform designed to help users understand the terrain of Jezero Crater and plan potential surface exploration routes using real planetary data. The platform provides a multi-scale mapping experience, allowing users to explore Mars through a 2D map and a 3D planetary globe, then zoom into Jezero Crater for detailed terrain analysis. Users can explore multiple data layers, including elevation, slope, geological formations, thermal conditions, radiation information, and Perseverance rover paths and photographs. Interactive map tools provide location-specific terrain information, while ground profile charts visualize elevation changes along selected routes. The core feature is Marswalk Route Planning. Users select a starting point and destination, and the system generates multiple walking route alternatives. Each route is evaluated using four weighted criteria: walking time (40%), steep terrain (30%), climbing (15%), and rough ground (15%). The platform ranks the alternatives and displays route statistics, elevation profiles, walking-time information, and potential hazards to help users compare options. Additional tools include interactive landmarks and place information, distance and area measurement, map layer controls, dataset legends, and a mission briefing containing environmental information such as daylight, radiation, gravity, and dust-storm conditions. The platform was developed using React and TypeScript for the frontend, CesiumJS, Three.js, and GSAP for mapping and 3D visualization, and Python FastAPI for backend services. Docker Compose was used for deployment. Red Compass transforms complex planetary datasets into an accessible exploration and planning environment. It is a planning prototype, not a real mission navigation system, and it does not certify any route as safe.
